children: China's Dalian Commodity Exchange will adjust the price limit range for iron ore futures contracts to 6% from 9% previously, it said on Monday.
It will also adjust the trading margin ratio for the iron ore futures contracts to 8% from the previous 11%, its statement said.
Both changes will be effective from the settlement on September 9.
